title: SSS-grade Talent
html:
I frowned at Yoo Joonghyuk's words.

Head east right now?

I saved his life, and now he's giving me orders.

I was a little irritated, but before I could even reply, Yoo Joonghyuk continued.

―The ‘Disaster of Questions’ is awakening.

······What?

Apparently frustrated that I wasn't getting it, Yoo Joonghyuk spoke with a frown.

―Someone is awakening the disasters.

●

A little later, Han Sooyoung and I were heading toward Gangdong-gu, leaving Lycaon behind, still absorbed in his enlightenment.

At tremendous speed, too.

“Is it okay to just leave that wolf behind?”

“The Imyuntar can sense the owner of the protection amulet. He'll find his way to us when he comes to. More importantly······.”

I spoke, shooting a sideways look at Han Sooyoung as she ran beside me.

“Can't you carry him? You could use your avatar.”

“No.”

Recoiling at the idea, Han Sooyoung put distance between us in an instant.

“Didn't you just say Yoo Joonghyuk might not be a bad guy?”

“That's one thing. This is another. Could you carry the bastard who cut your head off?”

When she put it that way, her point made sense. I couldn't argue.

Yoo Joonghyuk spoke to me through [Midday Tryst].

―You can leave me behind. I don't need help.

―Enough with the needless pride. I might actually leave you behind.

With him on my back, I couldn't see Yoo Joonghyuk's expression.

―How long until you can move on your own?

―Two more days.

―You're going to kill me once you recover, aren't you?

I'd asked half jokingly, but the bastard gave no answer, making me nervous.

I deliberately slowed down.

―If that's how you're going to be, I can't help you. How am I supposed to trust and help someone who's trying to kill me? Take an [Oath of Existence], and I'll help. Swear you won't kill me until this round is over.

―I cannot do that.

Petty bastard.

―Then at least swear you won't harm me before the fifth scenario ends. If you can't even do that, I really can't help you.

After considering it for a moment, Yoo Joonghyuk answered.

―I swear.

Surprisingly, Yoo Joonghyuk readily agreed.

An Oath of Existence. A restriction you placed on yourself.

Something like cold flames rose from Yoo Joonghyuk's body, then burrowed toward his heart. If he broke his oath, those blue flames would burn his heart. Just as I was feeling a little reassured, Yoo Joonghyuk continued.

―I won't kill you. But······.

―But?

―I will hit you once.

―What?

I went blank for a moment. Even in all this, he wanted to hit me?

―Don't tell me this is about what happened two days ago.

Again, Yoo Joonghyuk gave no answer.

I'd thought it was strange that Yoo Joonghyuk, of all people, had given in so easily.

―······Just once. And go easy on me. Got it?

Fine. If taking a punch could mend my relationship with Yoo Joonghyuk, maybe that wouldn't be such a bad thing.

As I was now, at least Yoo Joonghyuk wouldn't kill me with a single blow.

Before long, we crossed Cheongdam Bridge and entered Gwangjin-gu.

I could feel the surrounding ecosystem gradually changing.

Plants I'd never seen before sprouted along the foul-smelling streets, and the stench of monster urine and feces began to fill the air, replacing the smell of rotting corpses.

I saw the stems of enormous plants rising from the ground and winding around the nearby high-rises.

[The grade 7 plant species, ‘Yanaspreta’, is wary of you.]

I spoke to Han Sooyoung as she drew her weapon.

“Don't make any rash moves. We'll be fine as long as we don't attack first.”

“······Don't things like that usually launch sudden tentacle attacks?”

“Only in comics. They're docile. Careful not to step on those roots.”

From the top of a building, a sunflower-like plant head tracked us with its eyes. It looked frightening, but it was actually a friendly monster. That didn't mean we could be optimistic about the situation, though.

Plant species normally didn't cross over until just after the [Great Hole] had opened completely.

“Looks like Chronos's terraforming has begun.”

Terraforming (Terraforming).

The fifth scenario was, in essence, a clash between worlds.

Humanity fighting against an invading otherworld.

Just as Chronos was encroaching on Seoul, the ‘Third Murim World’ would be encroaching on China, and the ‘World of a Hundred Yokai (百妖界)’ on Japan.

Han Sooyoung spoke as she scouted the area with her avatars.

“It's nothing but monster colonies everywhere. Damn it.”

“If a disaster is awakening, the terraforming must have sped up too.”

“Who the hell is awakening a disaster?”

“Probably someone like you. You woke up the fire dragon too.”

Han Sooyoung stuck out her lower lip.

“······That one was manageable, wasn't it?”

“That's because the intermediate dokkaebi imposed a penalty on the fire dragon that time. And it wasn't manageable. Don't talk so lightly just because you weren't the one who killed it.”

“Won't there be a penalty this time too? If we kill a weakened disaster, wouldn't that actually work in our favor?”

“Penalties are meaningless against the ‘Disaster of Questions’. And I doubt the dokkaebis would impose one in the first place.”

We moved swiftly, avoiding the monster colonies. All along the streets, packs of ground rats and grolls were tearing into corpses.

Judging by the remains of slain monsters, Yoo Joonghyuk had probably fought his way along this road to reach me.

He'd covered this much distance in that condition. Yoo Joonghyuk really was impressive.

I spoke to Yoo Joonghyuk.

―There's something I'm curious about.

―······.

―Why did you come looking for me? Honestly, I thought you'd kill yourself straight away if you ended up like that.

―Kill myself? Ridiculous.

The bastard wouldn't say that if he'd seen his own future in the eighth round.

But his next words caught me a little off guard.

―If I were going to give up that easily, I would never have begun this journey.

For the first time in ages, I remembered how I'd felt when I first read ‘Ways of Survival’. I wondered if Han Sooyoung might be right. The ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ I'd always believed I knew was a Yoo Joonghyuk who gave up easily and killed people easily, his mind worn down by countless repeated tragedies.

But the Yoo Joonghyuk of the third round wasn't like that yet.

Maybe I didn't know the third-round Yoo Joonghyuk very well.

[Your understanding of the character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ has increased.]

After a brief pause, Yoo Joonghyuk spoke.

―You were the only one who came to mind. You're capable of destroying the ‘Absolute Throne’, so I thought you might be of some use.

―You're not going to give me grief for destroying the throne?

―I don't want to argue over something that's already happened. Besides, I had my own misgivings about it. You did it to keep out the ‘Outer Gods’, didn't you?

―······You knew?

I'd never spoken this openly with Yoo Joonghyuk before, so I was honestly surprised.

Leaving aside how cool he was being, had this bastard always been so smart?

Yoo Joonghyuk continued.

―Honestly, I thought it wasn't a bad approach. The problem is what came after. When you destroyed the throne, all the guides scattered, and collecting the meteorites became more difficult. That's also why the terraforming in Gwangjin-gu and Gangdong-gu has accelerated. Those wanderers are using the meteorites' power.

―What are you talking about? Just using a meteorite doesn't speed up terraforming.

―One of the Ten Evils (十惡) has obtained a ‘Disaster Meteorite’.

The Ten Evils. My heart sank at those words.

I'd expected it. But hearing it confirmed was another matter.

―Don't tell me it's Poison Beauty (毒嬉) Lee Seolhwa.

―······You knew.

―She's the only one who can use Thousand Spirits Poison.

But there was something I didn't understand.

―Then why were you poisoned? If you knew you were up against the Poison Beauty, you wouldn't have confronted her head-on either, would you?

―I tried to persuade her.

―Persuade her? You?

A scene that belatedly came to mind at that moment. Yoo Joonghyuk spoke.

―I thought I could make her a companion.

A companion······ Right.

Now I remembered.

Poison Beauty Lee Seolhwa had been Yoo Joonghyuk's companion in the second round.

Being one of the Ten Evils didn't mean someone always became a villain.

Just as Armed Fortress Master Gong Pildu had changed in this round, Lee Seolhwa had become one of the Ten Evils only in certain rounds, including the first. In every other round, Poison Beauty Lee Seolhwa was one of the few companions Yoo Joonghyuk could rely on.

―That wasn't like you.

―I admit it. It was pathetic.

―······.

―She wasn't the Lee Seolhwa I remembered. I know that. But even if only for a moment, I wanted to believe. That the woman in my memories was still alive. That we could be together in this round too.

My mouth fell open at the loneliness that slipped unwittingly into his words.

During his second round, Lee Seolhwa had briefly been Yoo Joonghyuk's lover.

―I understand.

Yoo Joonghyuk was silent for a moment.

―You speak as though you've regressed yourself.

―You don't have to regress to understand.

I knew at least that you shouldn't carelessly say you understood.

Still, I wanted to say it.

No one had ever understood him, and no one ever would. I thought at least I could say those words to him.

[The character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ is deeply shaken.]

[The character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ receives a faint measure of comfort.]

―Strange. You're clearly not a regressor······. Yet it feels as though you really know this feeling. Is that another ability of a prophet?

When I didn't answer, Yoo Joonghyuk continued.

―Of course, that doesn't mean I think well of you. You're a shameless bastard who kidnapped my little sister.

―I didn't kidnap her, okay? I was just protecting her. You must have verified that with [Lie Detection], so why do you keep······.

“Kim Dokja.”

At Han Sooyoung's tense voice, we stopped. The approach from Cheonho Bridge into Gangdong came into view. Things were intermittently crossing into Gangdong-gu from the [Great Hole], which shone brightly in midair.

Damn it. Already.

As we entered Gangdong-gu proper, the unfamiliar grasses covering the ground grew denser. Gloomy trees grew in rows between the buildings, and small monsters leaped through their branches.

Gangdong-gu was already halfway transformed into an otherworld (異界).

Biting her lip, Han Sooyoung asked,

“Aren't we too late? What if the ‘disaster’ has already awakened?”

“Probably not yet. We'd have received a scenario if it had.”

A little farther on, I spotted several markings scattered across the ground.

They looked like graffiti, but they were actually territorial markings.

A warning to come no closer.

From here on, this was definitely the Poison Beauty's territory. Like the other wanderers, she'd settled in Gangdong-gu and begun expanding her domain.

Things had progressed faster than I'd expected.

Han Sooyoung spoke.

“A group with defenses this good won't be easy to take on······. Have you got anything in mind?”

No.

We hadn't come to wage an all-out war in the first place.

“All we need is the meteorite. We just have to steal it. I'll buy you time, so you handle the meteorite.”

But it wouldn't be as easy as it sounded.

Things might be different if we had an ally like the ‘King of Wanderers’.

Yoo Joonghyuk interjected.

―There's no need to rush so much. Even if the disaster begins, the ‘Disaster of Questions’ can be suppressed in its early stages.

Suppressed in its early stages, huh.

Sure enough, that was the sort of arrogance only Yoo Joonghyuk could afford.

―Suppress it early? Who's going to do that? You, half crippled as you are?

―You, obviously. Weren't you planning to do that anyway?

―How does that follow?

―You must have already awakened the guide and learned [Way of the Wind].

Judging by the slight anger in his tone, he seemed annoyed that I'd taken the [Way of the Wind] he'd meant to learn. I grinned and told him,

―I couldn't learn it.

―······Why? Not enough time?

I wished that were the reason.

―No. Not enough talent.

I could feel profound contempt in Yoo Joonghyuk's silence.

―You bastard. If that was how it was going to be, then from the start······.

“People.”

At Han Sooyoung's words, I drew [Unbreakable Faith]. Anyone in the territory of one of the Ten Evils would naturally be that person's underling.

I handed Yoo Joonghyuk, who was on my back, over to Han Sooyoung's avatar.

“······I'm only carrying him for a minute, so take him back soon. Got it?”

The murmur of voices drew steadily closer. But something felt wrong. A single group moving together didn't usually make this much noise. Then a woman's clear voice rang out ahead.

“Everyone, run toward Cheonho Bridge!”

They weren't the Poison Beauty's group.

It didn't seem to be someone as influential as the ‘King of Wanderers’, but someone was helping people who'd survived a confrontation with the Poison Beauty's group escape Gangdong-gu. The unarmed survivors running toward us, gasping for breath, spotted us.

“M-move! Hurry!”

No sooner had he spoken than an arrow came flying. With a shrill whistle, it struck the man who'd spoken to me, and he collapsed. His back rapidly discolored where the arrow had struck, turning pitch-black. Poison.

“Catch those bastards!”

The Poison Beauty's group. Dozens of members, men and women alike, were firing arrows into the air in unison.

Shwaaaash!

Just as I was about to duck behind a building, a barrier of spiderweb-like threads spread across the air. As though dozens of layers of netting had been fired at once, the arrows tangled in the threads and could go no farther. Han Sooyoung's eyes widened.

“······What the hell kind of technique is that?”

The threads also shot toward the Poison Beauty's group charging up from behind. Threads like steel wires. So sharp that the legs of the people who tripped over them went flying.

“Aaaaargh!”

All the threads led back to one woman. A woman soaring through the air in a tight black combat suit that showed off her figure. Two knives extending from her fingertips danced spectacularly along threads of magic.

Freely adjusting the lengths of the threads, the woman swept away the charging members of the Poison Beauty's group in an instant.

Attacks without the slightest hesitation.

Movements so precise they were beautiful.

Neither the overall stats nor the skills behind those movements could have come from an ordinary constellation sponsor.

[This person's information cannot be viewed using ‘Character List’.]

[This person is not registered in ‘Character List’.]

A woman even [Character List] didn't work on.

Han Sooyoung muttered.

“Hey, that woman······.”

She didn't have to tell me. I already knew.

Because she was someone I knew.

“······Yoo Sangah-ssi?”

Meeting her again after two days, I found she was nothing like the Yoo Sangah I'd known.

Sh-sh-sh-shing!

With every movement of Yoo Sangah's daggers, her enemies' bodies were sliced apart while they were still alive.

Impressive.

······Was that really the Yoo Sangah I knew?

There weren't many anti-army skills capable of displaying that much power in a fight against multiple opponents. At this stage, that meant skills like Armed Fortress Master Gong Pildu's [Armed Zone] or Han Sooyoung's [Avatar]. Yet Yoo Sangah was displaying that much power without an anti-army skill.

How had she become so strong?

Was that what they called talent?

As though he'd read my thoughts, Yoo Joonghyuk spoke.

―She grows faster without you around. You don't seem to have much talent for developing your companions. It was the same with Lee Hyunsung.

―······She's grown that much because I gave her so much at the start, you jerk.

I hadn't actually given her much, but I wanted to say it anyway.

Damn it. Why had she become stronger precisely while I wasn't around?

This made it look as though I wasn't much help.

“Hey.”

At Han Sooyoung's voice, I belatedly nodded.

I couldn't stay mesmerized by Yoo Sangah's dazzling display forever.

After all, there were many enemies, and Yoo Sangah was alone.

“Yoo Sangah-ssi, this way!”

Yoo Sangah paused at the sound of my voice.

She apparently hadn't expected to run into me in a place like this either.

“Han Sooyoung, I'm counting on you.”

Han Sooyoung activated Avatar as though she'd been waiting for those words.

While dozens of avatars rushed out and disrupted the view of the Poison Beauty's group, I safely made contact with Yoo Sangah.

“Dokja-ssi? Here? How on earth······.”

“Let's move first, then talk.”

Reinforcements were pursuing us from a distance. Fortunately, the survivors seemed to have escaped Gangdong-gu safely across Cheonho Bridge. The problem was us.

―Go to the high-rise behind you. First, get to high ground and secure a view.

As expected, Yoo Joonghyuk's judgment was effective at times like this.

Even though I'd read all of ‘Ways of Survival’, I couldn't make every battlefield decision as well as Yoo Joonghyuk. But his next words were loaded with meaning.

―And you'd do well to be careful of that woman.

Be careful? Of whom?

Yoo Joonghyuk said no more.

We quickly slipped into a nearby high-rise and hid.

Perhaps stirred up by the commotion, monsters suddenly flooded the area, and the Poison Beauty's group seemed to have lost our trail. After searching the vicinity, they soon gave up the pursuit and returned deeper into Gangdong-gu.

Only then did I turn to Yoo Sangah.

“Yoo Sangah-ssi, are you all right?”

“Yes, I'm fine. What about you, Dokja-ssi?”

“I'm fine too.”

We'd been apart only a few days, but somehow our conversation felt awkward.

Like meeting an old classmate ten years after graduating from high school.

Making an effort to look away from her tight combat suit, I spoke.

“Well, um······.”

But I had no idea what to ask first.

Meanwhile, Yoo Sangah glanced at Han Sooyoung, then at Yoo Joonghyuk on her avatar's back, and gave me an inscrutable smile.

“It looks like a lot has happened to you too, Dokja-ssi.”

First, it was time to briefly catch up.

●

After the ‘Absolute Throne’ was destroyed, Yoo Sangah had landed in Gangdong-gu. Fortunately, someone else had landed there with her.

“Gong Pildu was with you?”

“Yes. Ajusshi helped me a lot.”

The way she called him ajusshi suggested they'd become quite close in that short time.

“Where did Gong Pildu go?”

“We got separated while fighting the Gangdong-gu group two days ago. He was trying to save me when······.”

Today was one surprise after another. Gong Pildu, one of the ‘Ten Evils’, had put himself in danger trying to save someone. Head bowed, Yoo Sangah struggled to continue.

“At the end, Ajusshi lured them toward the Han River······.”

For a moment, venom crept into Yoo Sangah's expression as she bit her lip hard.

Suddenly, I thought I understood why Yoo Sangah had taken down the Poison Beauty's group without hesitation.

I spoke to reassure her.

“Gong Pildu is probably fine. Don't worry.”

Since I had a contract with the [Defense Master], I would know immediately if Gong Pildu died. I'd suffer a penalty under the contract's terms. The fact that nothing had happened yet meant Gong Pildu was alive somewhere.

Like the Poison Beauty, Gong Pildu was one of the Ten Evils.

He wasn't someone who'd die that easily.

“Where did you get that suit and those daggers?”

“Oh, these······.”

After being separated from Gong Pildu, Yoo Sangah had wandered around the area and happened upon a [Green Meteorite]. A [Green Meteorite] contained rare items. I checked the items she had. Sure enough, I remembered there had been a meteorite containing items like these near Cheonho-dong.

[Ancient Assassin's Dagger]

[Floating Cat Leather Suit]

Both were excellent S-grade items.

The [Ancient Assassin's Dagger] had an option that increased damage the farther away its target was, while the [Floating Cat Leather Suit] had an option that made the wearer's movements more agile the longer they remained airborne.

“Those are good items.”

“Yes, they helped me fight well.”

When Yoo Sangah smiled, Han Sooyoung, who'd only been listening until then, picked a fight.

“Hmm. Is that really all there is to it?”

“Sorry?”

“Fine, let's say you got them ‘by chance’. But it makes no sense for you to fight like that with items alone. Who exactly is your sponsor? How did you level up [Agile Movement] or [Dagger Technique

Enhancement] so quickly? Even a ‘Growth Package’ couldn't make you grow that fast.”

“······Who are you?”

“Me? The First Apostle.”

Without a word, Yoo Sangah drew a dagger.

“Wait, Yoo Sangah-ssi. She isn't an enemy.”

Yoo Sangah looked at me with distrust in her eyes.

“Have you two gotten close already?”

“It's not that we've gotten close······.”

“People from the Chungmuro group died at her hands. Surely you haven't forgotten?”

Yoo Sangah had been Chungmuro's deputy representative while I was away.

Her affection for the Chungmuro group members would therefore run much deeper than mine. Han Sooyoung spoke.

“Chungmuro? Oh, right. You're that girl from back then?”

Yoo Sangah narrowed her eyes at the insolent tone.

Han Sooyoung smirked and added,

“Hey, Kim Dokja. Sure, I'm a nasty bitch, but use your judgment. If you ask me, there's something a little shady about that woman's background.”

“You······.”

“Since we're talking about Chungmuro, she wasn't this strong when I saw her there. Doesn't it seem strange to you too? Even with a Narrative-grade constellation as her sponsor, she couldn't grow so explosively in such a short time. Unless she had an SSS-grade growth acceleration skill······. But how many constellations in Korea could give her that kind of support?”

Emotionally, I wanted to deny it, but rationally, I thought Han Sooyoung was right. What Yoo Joonghyuk had said earlier bothered me too.

Besides, Yoo Sangah was still keeping her sponsor a secret from me.

Yoo Sangah's flustered eyes met mine.

I'd thought Yoo Sangah's sponsor was the ‘Abandoned Labyrinth's Lover’.

The only constellation capable of ‘Pathfinding’ through ‘Magic Thread’ was the person who'd given Theseus a ball of thread in Daedalus's labyrinth: ‘Ariadne’ of Greek mythology.

But as Han Sooyoung had said, ‘Ariadne’ wasn't well-known enough to make Yoo Sangah that strong.

Besides, the movements Yoo Sangah had shown while leaping through the air in the earlier battle looked closer to [Hermes's Walking Method], unless they were the Murim skill [Airwalking]. There was no way Ariadne's incarnation could use Hermes's stigma.

Just as I was about to speak, an unexpected presence cut in.

[Haha, everyone! Have you all been well?]

Damn it······ What timing.

I immediately looked out the window.

A dokkaebi floated in the darkening sky.

[The participants in this scenario are very impatient, aren't they? There's still a whole week before the main scenario begins, yet some of you are already awakening disasters. I take it you're awfully curious about the next scenario?]

The speaker wasn't Bihyung, though I could see Bihyung too.

Apparently, the low-grade dokkaebis were filling in because there was no one in charge.

[The dokkaebi in charge has stepped away for a bit, so we were going to take things easy in the meantime······ Haha. By now, you've all learned how things work, haven't you? You know we wouldn't just let an event like this pass us by, right?]

This wasn't good.

This really wasn't a good turn of events.

[When you want one so badly, I wouldn't be a dokkaebi if I didn't give you a scenario, would I?]

Receiving a scenario in a situation like this meant only one thing.

[The sub-scenario ― ‘Stop the Disaster’ has arrived.]

That the disaster was on the verge of hatching.

●

<Sub-scenario ― Stop the Disaster>

Category : Sub

Difficulty : S-

Clear Conditions : An unknown force that has settled in Gangdong-gu is attempting to hatch one of the ‘disasters’. Defeat them and stop the coming ‘disaster’.

Time Limit : 2 hours

Reward : 22000 coins

Failure : Early appearance of the ‘Disaster of Questions’.

●

Since we'd received the ‘Stop the Disaster’ scenario, the Poison Beauty's group must have received a ‘Protect the Disaster’ scenario.

These damned dokkaebis were trying to fold even this unexpected situation into the scenarios.

I immediately turned to my companions and spoke.

“This isn't the time to fight among ourselves. Let's deal with that first.”

For the first time, Han Sooyoung and Yoo Sangah nodded together.

●

The Poison Beauty's group had established its base in the Cheonho-dong area of Gangdong-gu.

More precisely, it was an area densely lined with Protestant and Catholic churches.

If their aim was to revive the disaster early, choosing an area full of religious institutions as their base was an excellent decision.

The prayers of people with nowhere left to go would create the right conditions for the ‘Disaster Meteorite’ to hatch.

Having finished scouting the area, Han Sooyoung spoke first.

“The least terraformed route is north-northeast of their base. Toward Cheonjung-ro 16-gil. If we can get in through there, we can reach the center of the base in the shortest possible time. But the defenses won't be easy to get through.”

I nodded.

We had no time, so we had to take the fastest route.

“It's all right. We can move through buildings as much as possible. Han Sooyoung, Yoo Sangah-ssi, please handle the front. And don't fight each other.”

“······All right.”

Since Yoo Joonghyuk couldn't help us right now, we decided to use Han Sooyoung's avatar to leave him on the high-rise's roof. Ostensibly, his role was to ‘observe the battle’. Yoo Joonghyuk didn't complain. He only offered this advice.

―If possible, defeat them before it hatches. Without [Way of the Wind], suppressing the ‘Disaster of Questions’ in its early stages is almost impossible.

Of course, I wanted to do that too, if possible.

“Let's go.”

At the signal, we jumped down from the building.

Han Sooyoung took the lead, using [Avatar]. Her avatars multiplied into dozens in an instant, running all over the streets and drawing the Poison Beauty's group's attention.

“What the hell! Kill them!”

The moment the startled group members chased after the avatars, thin, transparent threads flew through the air.

Sh-sh-shing!

“Aaaaargh!”

The men chasing the avatars caught their legs on the steel wires, which sliced them off. But that wasn't the end. Another steel wire lay in the path of their fall.

Shluck!

The men's heads went flying. It was a chilling double trap, designed with even the angles of their falls calculated. Han Sooyoung clicked her tongue.

“Wow. That's brutal.”

“You're hardly one to talk.”

Despite the murderous intent dripping from their conversation, the two worked together quite well. No, more than quite well. They were extremely effective.

Thanks to them, I easily slipped past the Poison Beauty's group's surveillance and penetrated the center of the base.

Finding the Disaster Meteorite wasn't difficult.

An enormous meteorite standing over eight meters tall.

Ruuuuumble······.

There it stood, pouring out streams of ominous aura as though announcing, “I'm a disaster, all right.”

I could definitely feel something inside it that couldn't even be compared to the fire dragon.

If we couldn't stop that thing, Seoul would certainly be finished.

And the figure of a woman standing beside the meteorite.

Hair as white as freshly fallen snow.

Looking at her lips, vivid as a red flower blooming on a snowy mountain, I could certainly understand Yoo Joonghyuk's taste.

The moment her chilling eyes fixed on me, a terrifying force radiated from her whole body.

The feeling of my skin prickling from her sheer presence alone.

It was a different kind of overwhelming pressure from what I'd felt with Gong Pildu.

I see.

So this was what she could do with the power of a [Disaster Meteorite]?

“······Who are you?”

She was Poison Beauty Lee Seolhwa, one of the Ten Evils.

There were three ways to awaken a [Disaster Meteorite].

The first was to let the meteorite hatch according to the scenario. The second was to draw upon the [Disaster Meteorite]'s power ahead of time. And the third, the fastest method, was to artificially supply the [Disaster Meteorite] with magic power.

Around Lee Seolhwa, ten-odd group members were offering prayers.

I could see the faint magic power flowing from their bodies feeding directly into the [Disaster Meteorite].

A hatching (孵化) ritual.

They'd chosen the third method.

Judging by how vigorously the meteorite was already heaving, another thirty minutes like this would have been enough for the disaster to hatch.

I glared at Lee Seolhwa and spoke.

“Why don't you stop? Unless you all want to die together.”

“······.”

“What on earth are you thinking?”

It was strange.

In the original novel's third round, before the disaster, Lee Seolhwa had borrowed the [Disaster Meteorite]'s power, but she hadn't been foolish enough to awaken the disaster early.

Yoo Joonghyuk must have sought out Lee Seolhwa beforehand because he knew that too.

“Stop the [Disaster Meteorite] from hatching. Then I'll let you all live.”

After studying me quietly, Lee Seolhwa spoke.

“And if I refuse?”

“You'll die here.”

A sneer crossed Poison Beauty Lee Seolhwa's face.

At a movement of her hand, the humans praying to the disaster all turned toward me at once.

[The grade 8 non-human species, ‘Insect Human (蟲人) Nam Minhyuk’, displays hostility toward you.]

[The grade 8 non-human species, ‘Insect Human Jung Minji’, displays hostility toward you.]
